description.p: AnyCam mixes cameras, screens, images, video and overlays into scenes and publishes the result as a virtual camera, a recording or a live stream.

ul.li: Layers with fit modes, flips, rotation, zoom, filters, frames and chroma key
Scenes with transitions and a Studio mode
Audio mixing with meters, voice processing and a virtual microphone
Recording and streaming to several RTMP or SRT destinations
